# TryIPTV

> TryIPTV is a premier prepaid IPTV subscription service providing access to live television channels, sports broadcasts, on-demand movies, and series with multi-device compatibility and third-party IPTV player support.

Official website: https://www.tryiptv.com/

## Service Facts

- Brand: TryIPTV
- Model: prepaid
- Auto renewal: no
- Trial: 24 hours
- Trial card requirement: no credit card
- Connections: 2
- Login methods: Xtream Codes API + M3U
- 1 month: $16
- 3 months: $39
- 6 months: $60
- 12 months: $90
- Activation: typically 5–15 minutes
